questions.q: What is Oracle's current cloud-native implementation methodology for Fusion Cloud projects?
questions.explain: Oracle True Cloud Method (TCM) is Oracle's current cloud-native delivery methodology, the successor to OUM, which itself replaced the older on-premise AIM methodology.

questions.q: Which phrase best summarizes TCM's guiding principle?
options: Customize everything to match legacy processes exactly
Test in production to save time
questions.explain: "Adopt, not adapt" means starting from Oracle's standard functionality and reference processes, extending only where a documented business need requires it.

questions.q: What is Oracle Cloud Success Navigator?
options: A General Ledger journal approval rule
The digital platform that operationalizes TCM with tasks, milestones, and quality standards
questions.explain: Oracle Cloud Success Navigator organizes the project into programs and milestones, assigns role-specific tasks, and applies Oracle's Cloud Quality Standards.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the seven TCM phases mentioned in this lesson?
questions.explain: TCM's phases are Engage, Drive, Design, Configure, Validate, Transition, and Realize. Cutover and Hypercare are later go-live activities covered in Chapter 5 of this course.

questions.q: What is the name of the fictional company used as a running example throughout this course?
questions.explain: Brightfield Industrial Group is the fictional mid-size industrial manufacturer whose implementation this course follows from requirements through go-live.
